chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ:

translations.en: Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal narrated from Tha‘labah ibn Maymun, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِجُزْءٍ مِنْ مَالِهِ فَقَالَ

translations.en: I asked Aba ‘Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who made a bequest of a portion of his wealth, and he said:
A portion is one out of ten.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ۝ ثُمَّ اجْعَلْ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ جَبَلٍ مِنْهُنَّ جُزْءًا ۝

translations.en: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: “Then place on every mountain a portion of them.”

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the meaning of a bequeathed “portion” of wealth, defining it as one-tenth. The Imam عليه السلام supports this ruling by citing the Qur'anic usage of جُزْء and relating it to the ten mountains mentioned in the verse.
en.seo_question: What does a “portion” of wealth mean in a bequest according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?

key_terms.أَوْصَى: he made a bequest in a will
